the copy number variation (CNV) of human satellite III (1q 12) with aging is associated with the stress of different nature, intensity, and timing.
the copy number variation of human satellite III in leukocyte DNA is associated with aging.
the satellite III content in human DNA is variable and is affected by the environmental factors.

the possibility of using the f-Sat III content in leukocyte DNA as a biomarker of the body’s response to stress.
the study of f-Sat III CNVs in aging and replicatively senescent cells and in the population.
the study of the f-SaIII content in the DNA of blood cells of the individuals born in the 20th century.

the f-Sat III content and variability in leukocytes reflect the individual’s ability to adapt to the environment.
satellite III CNV is associated with environmental and social stress.
the f-Sat III CNVs in different human populations are a result of the interplay of genetic and environmental factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the f-Sat III content in blood cells can be used to monitor the health status of the body.
the f-Sat III CNV is a sensitive indicator of the stress response of the organism and may be used for the early diagnostics of stress-related disorders.
the f-Sat III CNVs in different generations are related to the social and environmental stress of their childhood.

the satellite DNA CNVs in leukocytes and HSFs are a sensitive indicator of the body response to environmental and social stress.
